author: First State Times
title: NAR issues statement on House passage of 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act
text:
The National Association of REALTORS issued a statement on May 20 following the House’s passage of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act. Shannon McGahn, executive vice president and chief advocacy officer for the association, said the group supports this bipartisan housing package.
This legislation is described as one of the most significant bipartisan housing packages Congress has considered in decades. The bill aims to address housing supply and affordability challenges across the country.
“The National Association of REALTORS applauds House passage of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act, one of the most significant bipartisan housing packages Congress has considered in decades. From the beginning, NAR has strongly supported this sweeping legislation and worked closely with lawmakers in both chambers and the Administration to help advance real solutions to America’s housing supply and affordability challenges,” McGahn said.
She added, “This bill reflects the growing bipartisan consensus that the nation needs bold action to expand housing inventory, improve affordability, and create more pathways to homeownership and rental opportunity. Specifically, this amended bill provides communities with new resources and best practices to modernize zoning and boost supply, streamlines federal permitting, and expands financing options for manufactured and rural housing. The bill also modernizes key programs like CDBG and HOME to strengthen local housing investment, improves credit access for homebuyers, and helps ensure veterans take full advantage of their VA home loan benefits.”
McGahn called on further legislative action: “We encourage the Senate to advance this legislation and send it to the President’s desk. NAR looks forward to continuing our work with leaders in the House, Senate, and the Administration to move these housing solutions across the finish line for communities nationwide.”
The National Association of REALTORS represents professionals involved in residential and commercial real estate transactions nationwide.
